en: Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor associated with clinging... (Abbreviated. Under root condition: twenty-nine; under object condition: twenty-four ... pe ... under result condition: nine ... pe ...
under non-disappearance condition: twenty-nine. Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor not associated with clinging...

Dependent on a state that is neither unwholesome nor defiled... (Abbreviated. Under root condition: twenty-nine; under object condition: twenty-four ... pe ... under result condition: nine ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition: twenty-nine.
Dependent on a state that is unwholesome and associated with defilements … [arises] a state that is wholesome and dissociated from defilements.
